description: This file defines an abstract class 'CheckPermissionsVisitor' which is part of a permission verification framework in a resource policy system. It provides mechanisms for iterating over resource and subject nodes in a permission tree, calculating weighted permissions, and determining whether specific permissions are granted based on authorization subject IDs and expected permissions.

classes.name: CheckPermissionsVisitor
classes.description: An abstract class that implements permission checking logic by visiting resource and subject nodes within a permission policy tree.

methods.name: CheckPermissionsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the visitor with a resource pointer, authorized subject IDs, and expected permissions.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Visits a node in the permission tree, delegating to specific methods based on node type.

methods.name: visitSubjectNode
methods.description: Handles the visit to a subject node, setting whether permissions should be collected based on authorization subject IDs.

methods.name: visitResourceNode
methods.description: Handles the visit to a resource node, aggregating permissions if permissions are being collected.

methods.name: aggregateWeightedPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to accumulate permissions from resource nodes.

methods.name: getLocationInRelationToTargetPointer
methods.description: Determines the relative location of a resource node in relation to the target resource pointer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns true if the permission check passes based on accumulated weighted permissions.
